# SEO Production Decision Policy

The production queue is ordered by expected organic value, not by publication convenience.

A candidate is evaluated on first-party visibility, evidence confidence, current page fit, search intent, business relevance, information-gain potential, citation/link potential, implementation cost, destructive risk, cannibalization risk, and time to feedback.

Automatic `CREATE` requires stronger evidence and a higher value threshold than `REFRESH`. `MERGE` can win the strategic comparison but remains advisory. Low-confidence candidates become `MONITOR`, even if an LLM could easily write them.
